messages:
Eva L: Quick SEO ops thread for the webinar landing going live 05/05. Need final redirect map, JSON-LD Event schema, internal anchor links from /blog/ops and /docs/serve, and GA4->SFDC field mapping. Who owns redirects?

Sam K: I can take redirects + canonical checks. Please drop the GA4 export and any legacy paths.

Rina P: GA4 top paths pasted here: https://docs.google.com/example_export. Draft hero copy: "Join our webinar to see how Redwood Dedicated cuts inference latency and cost 12-minute demo + reproducible benchmarks." Thoughts?

Sam K: Draft redirect list (short):
```
/old-webinar -> /webinars/dedicated-2026 (301)
/blog/old-inference -> /blog/infra-performance (301)
/docs/serve-v1 -> /docs/serve/overview (301)
```
I'll stage these and run Screaming Frog after staging.

Noah B: For lead routing: include hidden fields utm_source, utm_campaign, demo_variant, gclid. We'll POST form to /api/lead-proxy/test-webhook for test. Need field names and example payload.

ops-bot: CDN deploy window available 05/03 02:00-04:00 UTC. 301 redirects supported. Please file deploy ticket 24h prior.

Rina P: Benchmark blurb for landing: "In our reproducible demo suite Redwood Dedicated achieved median p95 latency ~125ms while reducing cost per 1k tokens by ~40% vs baseline. See gated benchmark report for details."

Eva L: JSON-LD should include startDate, VirtualLocation URL, and performers. Sam or Norah please add to head template and confirm QA.

Sam K: JSON-LD snippet ready to paste in head (escaped here):
```
<script type="application/ld+json">{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Redwood Dedicated Webinar","startDate":"2026-05-05T18:00:00Z","location":{"@type":"VirtualLocation","url":"https://redwood.ai/webinars/dedicated-2026"},"performer":[{"@type":"Person","name":"Rina P."}],"description":"Demo + benchmarks for production inference."}</script>
```
I'll also add rel=canonical to /webinars/dedicated-2026 in the head.

Norah V: I'll inject internal links from /blog/ops and /docs/serve into the hero and FAQ modules in the CMS.

Eva L: Owners recap: redirects & canon (Sam), JSON-LD + head (Sam), hero + gated blurb (Rina), internal links (Norah), GA4->SFDC mapping & webhook (Noah). Ping here when complete and react with :white_check_mark:.
